== English Decipher comparison ==
The November 1998 Glossary broadens the piloting bonus from a starship to anything Gailid pilots. Free deployment with Mosep and the Audience Chamber drain bonus are unchanged. Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=64 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 64.
